title: cxpm
content:
Describe your C++ project in C++. cxpm is a package manager and build tool for C++. A project is described in a package.cpp, cxpm fetches and builds what it depends on, and the result is handed to the package manager of the system it is installed on.

title: How cxpm is linked
content:
How cxpm is linked cxpm installs software into sysroots and is itself meant to be dropped into one, so it cannot lean on whatever C++ runtime the host happens to have. This page records what is linked statically, what is not, and why.

title: Roadmap
content:
Roadmap cxpm is being redesigned from a build tool that sits beside CMake into the tool that replaces it: a package manager that fetches a project’s dependencies, builds against a sysroot made of exactly those dependencies, and hands the result to the package manager of the system it is installed on.
